runner_events.interpretation: Runner lifecycle completed; its final internal acceptance boundary was 31/34, distinct from the platform final 19/34.

flow_timeout_evidence: REQ-2.2 implement FAILED in 900s; rewrite repair 1 FAILED in 599s

timeout_chain.finding: Four unique implement turns hit the 900-second Octos cap; one additional REQ-2.2 repair hit 599 seconds.
The timed-out turns were tool-heavy (23, 24, 40 and 78 tool starts), and repair attempts also hit the request-budget-10 guard.
Two REQ-2.2 acceptance attempts observed ConnectionResetError for GET /favicon.ico while the backend was still running.
REQ-5.2.2 ended with one HTTP 400 proxy_error unexpected EOF after 348 seconds.
Postflight found 210 stray processes, but cgroup memory.events reports zero OOM kills and peak memory was below half of the 2 GiB limit.
The generated app reached the evaluator and 19 tests passed; the 15 failures are all 10-second locator waits, not a runner-wide startup failure.

optimization_opportunities.action: Split each implementation into a bounded inspect -> minimal edit -> build/smoke checkpoint, with an explicit early stop before the 900-second cap and reserved repair budget.
optimization_opportunities.why: The 51000-second global budget was not exhausted; individual turns and tool-heavy exploration were the limiting path.
optimization_opportunities.validation: Track per-turn wall time, tool count, wrote/verified, and acceptance result; require repair budget to remain above 300 seconds when a node fails.

optimization_opportunities.action: Do not spend repair turns on repeated full-file exploration or a full rewrite after an identical failure; use a small patch turn tied to the first failing locator.
optimization_opportunities.why: REQ-2.2 consumed a 900-second implementation plus a 599-second rewrite and still had no repair budget; several later repairs hit request-budget-10 guards.
optimization_opportunities.validation: Bound repeated reads and require a concrete file edit or a recorded no-change diagnosis before another acceptance round.

optimization_opportunities.action: Make the smoke server lifecycle PID-scoped and ensure unknown paths such as /favicon.ico return a clean 404 without resetting the socket.
optimization_opportunities.why: The trace records two ConnectionResetError observations and postflight had to kill 210 stray processes; this is an infrastructure/noise amplifier, not by itself proof of the 15 final DOM failures.
optimization_opportunities.validation: Run repeated fresh-process acceptance with no orphan count growth, a 404 response for favicon, and no connection reset.

optimization_opportunities.action: Treat provider proxy_error unexpected EOF as a bounded retryable transport event, preserving the node checkpoint instead of consuming a feature repair cycle.
optimization_opportunities.why: REQ-5.2.2 stopped at the provider boundary after 348 seconds with wrote=true but verified=false.
optimization_opportunities.validation: Record request ID, retry count, backoff and resumed node state without claiming the feature passed.

optimization_opportunities.action: For the generated application, inspect the 15 missing accessible locators as separate UI/data-contract hypotheses; do not raise the Playwright timeout globally.
optimization_opportunities.why: The final failures cluster into login/global identity (8), shelf/book form controls (5) and shelf-context navigation (2), while 19 tests pass.
optimization_opportunities.validation: Stage 4 should use template/static snapshots and a fresh local reproduction to distinguish missing DOM, seed/route mismatch, navigation race and backend response failure.
